Montreal Polymers replaces toxic chemical washing machines and hazardous incinerators
with pure cold mechanical granulation — turning industrial PVC off-cuts into circular raw materials.
Primary Material: Rigid PVC, Siding & Piping Off-cuts
Logistics: Free Roll-off Bins & Freight Covered in QC/ON
Traditional recyclers submerge polymers in caustic acid baths or high-heat incinerators,
releasing dangerous chlorine VOCs and generating toxic slurry that threatens local soil.
At Montreal Polymers, we engineered a 100% Cold Mechanical Separation process:
ambient-temperature rotary shredding, acoustic dust aspiration, and optical color sorting.
Drop-off roll-off bins across QC & ON
Turnkey solutions for extrusion plants, window fabricators, and commercial converters.
